fixes.what: The right trunk's mask runs the wrong way relative to its clip edge: invert it so the fade ends at the clip edge (mirror of the left strip), e.g. linear-gradient(to left, transparent calc(100% - var(--edge-space)), #000 calc(100% - var(--edge-space) + 72px)) — verify at 1440 where --edge-space (~280px) nears the 20vw strip width.
fixes.why: At 1440 the right strip shows a hard edge instead of a fade.

fixes.what: Anchor the canopy by the bottom instead of top:35% (bottom:-4%; top:auto; width:min(100%,165vh); max-height:68vh; object-fit:cover; object-position:center top) so the fruit band sits lower and the middle stays open on tall desktops.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-0 the canopy climbs into the descriptor line.

fixes.what: Phone accordion panels: min-height 340px, padding-bottom 56px and padding-left 56px, or hide the motion toggle while an open panel is under it.
fixes.why: In index-phone-1 the gold-bordered Pause button stamps over the open panel text.

fixes.what: Replace the full perimeter border with a bottom-only rule: border:0; border-bottom:2px solid rgba(201,158,92,.45); background:rgba(27,34,30,.55).
fixes.why: Boxed inputs read as generic; an underline reads editorial and matches the kashida.

fixes.what: Constrain the vertical gold labels: max-height calc(100% - 64px), overflow hidden, ellipsis, nowrap, bottom 24px.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-2 the long vertical labels (Mehndi & Sangeet, Haldi & Pheras) run into the strip edge.

note: Captured from the Gemini web app (4 Argon) on the pass-5 build; 6th fix truncated in capture.
